name: all-templates
description: A list of business types, as a dry run: nothing is created. The list enters at `list`; `dispatch` answers it as an array and `each` sends one type per signal to `template`, the one-type network as one neuron, which answers what it would do for that type. all.apply.network.json is the same network over the file that applies.

neurons.description: Answers the list as an array of { type } (neurons/dispatch/dispatch.mjs); `each` forwards one signal per item.

One type's whole job, the network in template.network.json: plan, create, verify. It states `effect` because `create` inside is one: once that has started, the call is never cut and a failure is `unknown`. `retry` starts a failed type again, which is safe because `create` is idempotent by the repo's name.
